exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Modals for suggestions — should, could

items.prompt: You ___ always check quality — it is essential.
items.hintAfterError: Para um conselho forte (é essencial), use o modal de recomendação, não o de sugestão.

items.prompt: We ___ also consider suppliers in Vietnam — it is just an idea.
The buyer ___ visit the factory before signing.
You ___ ask for samples first — that is one option.
We ___ choose a supplier only because of price.
items.hintAfterError: É um conselho negativo: modal de recomendação + 'not'.
